claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: The report confirms it is a gearbox, but cannot verify the seller's business status or the origin of the part.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (slipping clutches, broken gears, or damaged torque converter).
risks.proof: Video of the donor vehicle operating or a diagnostic report from a transmission specialist.

risks.risk: Incompatibility with the target vehicle due to unknown model/make.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the identification tag or stamped model code on the transmission housing.

risks.risk: Electrical failure or sensor damage due to cut wires.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all electrical connectors and sensors to assess repairability.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a complete wiring harness and sensor replacement.

risks.risk: Starter motor is dead or seized.
risks.proof: Video of a bench test showing the starter motor engaging and spinning.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the transmission identification plate or stamped model number on the casing.
Close-up photo of the starter motor label to read the part number.
Video showing the input shaft being rotated by hand to check for smooth movement.
Photos of all electrical plugs to see the extent of the wire cutting.
response.reason: The specific vehicle compatibility (make/model) is missing, which is essential for valuation. The presence of cut wires and lack of identification makes even a worst-case price unreliable.
